dedup.scope: Public metadata index of 14878 items, the 3202-row retired-claim record and the 162-row current worklist were searched with the terms D-group, perfect pairing of finite groups, duality for complexes of tori, Demarche, Harari, Poitou-Tate and Artin-Mazur-Milne; only problem_id 1933 and the published task A-1933-poitou-tate-I (problem_id 900000016) come from this source, and neither is this claim. scouting/algebra/SELECTION.md asks for the local and global independent conclusions of this source other than the already counted character duality, and this is exactly such a local-global conclusion. Focused comparison of the actual near neighbours.

compared.statement: Integral compact-support character duality for two-term torus complexes on curves over finite fields, including primary characteristic torsion (source Theorem refin2, lines 1760-1781).
compared.difference: That item pairs cohomology groups of the complex itself with completions of compact-support groups of the dual complex; the counted statement here pairs the finite D-groups of the complex and of its dual at the first level, and it also uses that theorem as a retained ingredient rather than restating it.

compared.statement: Poitou-Tate I for two-term torus complexes over a positive-characteristic global field (source Theorem spt1, lines 2515-2537; published task A-1933-poitou-tate-I).
compared.difference: A global nine-term exact sequence with restricted products and the groups Sha; the counted statement here is a two-group perfect pairing on one open curve with no restricted product, and it is used inside the proof of that global sequence rather than following from it.
